c2_bad.why: Keyboard type, autofill hints, return-key action and scrolling the focused field above the IME have nothing to do with viewing attached photos. It was pulled in only because 'on-screen keyboard (IME) aware layout' was listed as a required concern for a photo-viewing task.

c2_direction_unjustified.why: imagery-none ('remove stock photos, abstract blobs and hero illustrations') on a task whose entire subject is making user-captured defect photos large enough to inspect. Harmless if read carefully, misleading if followed literally; the c1 run explicitly recorded it as ignored because it contradicts the task.

why: c2 leads with media-photo-viewer, which states almost exactly the implementation that was actually built (2-up thumbnails decoded at display size x DPR, full-screen route closed by system back, pinch/double-tap zoom plus an explicit zoom button, labelled prev/next, dark chrome with 48dp high-contrast controls, report state preserved), and it drops c1's off-task comp-form and typo-scale-and-roles; imagery-none survives only as a low-harm direction slot instead of a core record.
